verdictStatement: ACCEPT at 0 blockers and 0 SHOULD-FIX. Every attack on the dispatch list is refuted against live bytes. The harness object is == exact to live parent v3 harnesses[DR-G04], equal again under canonical serialisation and identical in key order. The parent pin is CGHS v3 175723e3 and measures true, and it is the only digest the subject cites. Path occupancy holds by the strongest available test: the carried artifactPathWhenAuthored string is character-equal to the subject's own path and a file exists there, so the D-086 promise is occupied by the file that claims to occupy it. OBL-2 is untouched and the live parent still holds it open, no D-006 unit or binary-MB constant is invented and the only arithmetic in the file is the Linux kB-to-bytes conversion, analyze and consented-probe RSS are excluded on three surfaces, nothing is QUALIFIED or SATISFIED, required-now is unchanged, and the subject did not move. I ran six further refutations of my own — that the claim or owner diverges from the live DR-G04 row, that protocol contradicts passProperty, that d006UnitStanding dangles, that child-process RSS is under-determined, that the authorityClaim is thinner than the corpus standard, and that 'independently reviewed' overstates a single-reviewer parent — and all six failed. The fifth was settled by measuring all five G01-G05 v1 extraction files and finding one uniform shape with a character-identical authorityClaim, with every omitted denial carried by the parent this file pins.
